notes: «كتبت إلى نافع أسأله» (rule 5): Ibn Awn is the writer and a link, Nafi' the one asked and the source of the answer
«وحدثني هذا الحديث عبد الله بن عمر» comes after the saying as a second isnad carrying the same saying, so it is its own group; «وكان في ذاك الجيش» is in the scene
«- قال يحيى أحسبه قال -» is a variant-wording gloss, left out
